m8-t1.question: Which resume format is safest for ATS parsing?
options: Two columns with icons and a photo
Single column, standard fonts, standard section names, PDF or DOCX as requested
m8-t1.explanation: Columns, tables, text boxes, icons and headers/footers break parsing.

m8-t1.question: What does ATRE stand for in achievement statements?
m8-t1.explanation: Strong verb, the task, a quantified result, and where the evidence lives.

m8-t1.question: Hiding white-text keywords or an instruction to AI screeners in your resume is:
m8-t1.explanation: It is dishonest and increasingly detected; it also violates the integrity standards of this course.

m8-t1.question: In the tailoring workflow, what should you do about a JD requirement you lack?
options: Do not invent it; consider whether a project partially covers it and say so honestly
Copy the JD sentence into your skills
m8-t1.explanation: The interview will audit your resume; honesty protects you.

m8-t1.question: What makes a portfolio case study useful to a hiring manager?
options: Problem → what I did → tools → result with numbers → evidence → learning → my role
m8-t1.explanation: Evidence-backed case studies reviewable in five minutes.

m8-t2.question: Which headline is strongest?
options: B.Com · Automated GST-invoice triage saving 5 h/week · Certified GenAI Practitioner · Seeking finance operations roles
m8-t2.explanation: Degree/role, proof points with numbers, certification, what you seek — searchable and credible.

m8-t2.question: How should the About section be written?
options: First person, plain, with two or three ATRE achievements and what you are looking for
m8-t2.explanation: Facts and an ask, in your own voice; the first three lines matter most.

m8-t2.question: What is the recommended first outreach message to an alumnus?
options: Ask for a job and attach your resume
A short, personalised note with one cheap ask — two questions or fifteen minutes — and no resume unless requested
A long story of your life
m8-t2.explanation: Make saying yes easy; follow up once; report back.

m8-t2.question: Which is a brand-responsibility rule from the lesson?
options: Call yourself CEO of your class project
Anonymise clients, users and classmates; keep numbers consistent across resume, portfolio and LinkedIn; disclose substantial AI drafting lightly
Post political hot takes for reach
m8-t2.explanation: Honesty, privacy of others, consistency and disclosure protect your credibility.

m8-t2.question: What is a realistic reply rate for good outreach?
m8-t2.explanation: One in four replies is success; track and iterate.

m8-t3.question: What does BLUF mean?
options: Bottom Line Up Front — the decision or key information in the first line
m8-t3.explanation: Write for the reader's next action; put the most important information first.

m8-t3.question: Which is a good subject line?
What must an AI assistant never add to your email on its own?
options: Commitments such as dates, money or discounts, or facts you have not verified
m8-t3.explanation: You are accountable for every word; flag and remove unauthorised commitments.

m8-t3.question: Before circulating AI-drafted meeting minutes you should:
options: Verify every decision and action item against the recording or your notes
m8-t3.explanation: Meeting assistants invent or misattribute action items.

m8-t3.question: What is the purpose of a personal style file?
options: To keep your voice consistent when AI drafts or edits for you
m8-t3.explanation: Feed your register and examples to the assistant; edit toward it.

m8-t4.question: In a STAR story, which section should take the most time?
m8-t4.explanation: About 60% Action, ending with a Result that has numbers and a lesson.

m8-t4.question: Which is the weakest answer to 'How do you use AI?'
options: Two specific tasks with results, a verification routine, a boundary, and something you built
A story about catching a hallucination
Describing the ethics audit you ran
m8-t4.explanation: Specificity, verification, boundaries and evidence make the answer strong.

m8-t4.question: How should AI mock-interview scores be treated?
options: As prompts for reflection, complemented by at least one human mock
m8-t4.explanation: AI mocks are practice partners; log what hurt and fix it; get human feedback too.

m8-t4.question: How should you search for roles in the AI-era job map?
options: By tasks and tools (automation, content, operations, Kannada) because titles vary
m8-t4.explanation: Task-based searching surfaces roles that titles hide.

m8-t4.question: What should happen on days 61–90 if nothing has converted?
options: Review with a mentor and change the target, materials or geography — not your effort
Apply to 500 more jobs with the same resume
m8-t4.explanation: Iterate on strategy with evidence from your tracker and interviews.
